How 2014 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Faction: Germany national team — Germany won the 2014 World Cup in Brazil.
  • Location: Maracanã — The 2014 World Cup final was played at the Maracanã.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 2014 tournament is Germany's Rio World Cup.

What is 2014 FIFA World Cup?

The 2014 World Cup in Brazil is remembered for Germany's 7–1 semi-final against the hosts and Mario Götze's extra-time winner against Argentina in the Rio final.
